description: Unit test class for DefaultMetadataHeader in the Eclipse Ditto project, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and comparison logic.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeaderTest
classes.description: Test suite for DefaultMetadataHeader including general functionality and comparison tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DefaultMetadataHeader instances are immutable and that their key and value are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods in DefaultMetadataHeader.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullKey
methods.description: Tests that passing null as key to the factory method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullValue
methods.description: Tests that passing null as value to the factory method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getKeyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the key returned from the header matches the one used during creation.

methods.name: getValueReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the value returned from the header matches the one used during creation.

methods.name: getInstanceFromNullJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to fromJson throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getInstanceFromNullLiteral
methods.description: Checks that missing the key field in JSON throws JsonMissingFieldException.

methods.name: getInstanceFromJsonObjectWithoutMetadataValue
methods.description: Checks that missing the value field in JSON throws JsonMissingFieldException.

methods.name: getInstanceFromJsonWithInvalidMetadataEntryKey
methods.description: Tests that an invalid metadata key in JSON throws JsonParseException.

classes.name: CompareToTest
classes.description: Parameterized tests for comparing DefaultMetadataHeader instances based on key and value.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Provides test cases with different headers and expected comparison results.

methods.name: compareToWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Asserts that compareTo produces expected ordering based on key and value.
